summary: This short wiki note covers the basketball career of Jimmie Baker, a player drafted by the Philadelphia 76ers in the 1975 NBA Draft. It also records that he played five games for the Kentucky Colonels of the American Basketball Association during the 1975-76 season.
one_line: Jimmie Baker is a basketball player drafted 39th overall by the Philadelphia 76ers in 1975 who later played five ABA games for the Kentucky Colonels.
key_facts: Jimmie Baker was selected by the Philadelphia 76ers in the 3rd round of the 1975 NBA Draft.
Jimmie Baker was the 39th pick overall in the 1975 NBA Draft.
Jimmie Baker played for the Kentucky Colonels in the American Basketball Association.
Jimmie Baker played 5 games for the Kentucky Colonels during the 1975-76 ABA season.
